say:0:1222601001:0.text: Sonja has been looking for you. She's waiting at the Whispers Office.
say:0:1222601001:0.source_cn: 主人，索尼娅之前派人来找，说她会在血薇帮话事处等你。
say:0:1222601001:0.male: Sonja has been looking for you. She's waiting at the Whispers Office.
say:0:1222601001:0.female: Sonja has been looking for you. She's waiting at the Whispers Office.

say:1:1222601002:0.text: She wouldn't have called for us if it wasn't important.
say:1:1222601002:0.source_cn: 她不是小题大做的个性，想必是遇到了什么难题。去看看吧。
say:1:1222601002:0.male: She wouldn't have called for us if it wasn't important.
say:1:1222601002:0.female: She wouldn't have called for us if it wasn't important.
